title: Token API file
description: Schema for one base/<name>.tokens.json or components/<name>.tokens.json file: a W3C DTCG-shaped tree (https://tr.designtokens.org/format/). See token-api/README.md for the full conversion-rule rationale and the resolution algorithm; this file is the machine-checkable version of the output shape only, it does not (and can't) encode the resolution algorithm itself.

group.description: A plain nesting group: any object that is not itself a leaf (see "leaf"). Recurses arbitrarily deep; a real path segment can also be the literal string "@base" (see README's @base note).

leaf.description: A single token. Distinguished from a group by having a $value key, DTCG's own convention (mirrors Firefox's native "any object with a value key is a leaf" rule that sync.py converts from).

$value.description: A literal (string/number/boolean), a single {group.path} alias reference string (see README's resolution algorithm), or, for a theme-dimension-keyed token, the single most-typical branch already picked out of $extensions["org.mozilla.themes"] by sync.py.

$type.description: Present when sync.py's infer_type() could determine one (see README "Conversion rules applied"). Absent, not guessed, when genuinely ambiguous or when decomposing a composite (border/shadow) would require restructuring $value itself.

$description.description: From the source token's own "comment" field, only when present at the leaf's own top level.

org.mozilla.themes.description: Present only for a theme-dimension-keyed token: the complete original value object (forcedColors/brand/nativeTheme/platform/light/dark/prefersContrast/default branches), preserved losslessly even though $value above only surfaces the single most-typical one.

org.mozilla.meta.description: Any non-value/comment sibling key found on the real source leaf (e.g. "override": true), preserved verbatim since DTCG has no first-class slot for it.
